Watch: Keep a close eye on any follow-through from today's positive market sentiment, and how the broader chip sector reacts to ongoing Nvidia-related news.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your leveraged, deeply underwater positions.
plays: Re-evaluate stops on all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, MUU, PLTU, MSFU, METU, SPAL); current stops are not protecting capital.
Consider trimming SOXL (-85.75%) and MUU (-74.64%) on any strength, given their decay and your margin exposure.
No new buys today - hold and watch for clearer signals.
